_meta.description: Ho so benh an dien tu mo phong (Long-term Memory cua Agent) - du lieu phuc vu Lab 3, KHONG phai du lieu y te that
_meta.disclaimer: Agent chi TOM TAT tien su da ghi nhan va GOI Y bac si theo chuyen khoa. Agent KHONG chan doan benh va KHONG ke don thuoc.

chronic_conditions: Viem da day HP duong tinh

visit_history.symptoms: Dau thuong vi am i sau an, o hoi, day bung keo dai 3 tuan
visit_history.diagnosis: Viem da day HP duong tinh
visit_history.treatment: Phac do diet HP 14 ngay (khang sinh + PPI)
visit_history.follow_up_note: Hen noi soi kiem tra lai sau 3 thang. Kieng ruou bia, an dung gio.

visit_history.symptoms: Tai kham dinh ky, con day hoi nhe buoi sang
visit_history.diagnosis: Viem da day on dinh, HP am tinh sau dieu tri
visit_history.treatment: Duy tri che do an, khong dung thuoc them
visit_history.follow_up_note: Theo doi 6 thang. Neu dau tro lai can noi soi som.

visit_history.symptoms: Dau that lung sau khi ngoi lam viec keo dai, te nhe chan phai
visit_history.diagnosis: Thoai hoa cot song that lung muc do nhe
visit_history.treatment: Vat ly tri lieu 10 buoi, huong dan tu the ngoi dung
visit_history.follow_up_note: Tap the duc cot song deu dan, tranh ngoi qua 2 gio lien tuc.

chronic_conditions: Trao nguoc da day thuc quan (GERD)

visit_history.symptoms: O chua, nong rat sau xuong uc ve dem, kho nuot nhe
visit_history.diagnosis: Trao nguoc da day thuc quan do B
visit_history.treatment: PPI 8 tuan, nang dau giuong khi ngu
visit_history.follow_up_note: Tranh an truoc khi ngu 3 gio. Tai kham neu trieu chung tro lai.

visit_history.symptoms: Trieu chung trao nguoc tai phat sau khi ngung thuoc
visit_history.treatment: PPI duy tri lieu thap, dieu chinh che do an
visit_history.follow_up_note: Can theo doi dai han. Neu tai phat lan 3 nen noi soi danh gia lai.

visit_history.symptoms: Hoi hop danh trong nguc khi gang suc, huyet ap 150/95
visit_history.diagnosis: Tang huyet ap do 1, roi loan lipid mau
visit_history.treatment: Thuoc ha ap hang ngay + statin, theo doi huyet ap tai nha
visit_history.follow_up_note: Tai kham moi 3 thang. Giam muoi, tap the duc 30 phut/ngay.

visit_history.symptoms: Tai kham dinh ky, huyet ap trung binh 132/84
visit_history.diagnosis: Tang huyet ap kiem soat tot
visit_history.treatment: Duy tri phac do hien tai
visit_history.follow_up_note: Tiep tuc theo doi huyet ap, tai kham sau 3 thang.

visit_history.symptoms: Thi thoang chong mat khi dung day nhanh
visit_history.diagnosis: Ha huyet ap tu the nhe, nghi do lieu thuoc
visit_history.treatment: Dieu chinh giam lieu thuoc ha ap
visit_history.follow_up_note: Theo doi sat trong 1 thang, bao ngay neu chong mat tang.

visit_history.symptoms: Ho ve dem, kho khe khi thay doi thoi tiet
visit_history.diagnosis: Hen phe quan muc do nhe
visit_history.treatment: Thuoc xit du phong, huong dan dung buong dem
visit_history.follow_up_note: Tranh khoi bui, long thu. Tai kham moi 3 thang.

visit_history.symptoms: Con hen nhe khi troi lanh, van dung thuoc du phong deu
visit_history.diagnosis: Hen phe quan kiem soat mot phan
visit_history.treatment: Tang lieu du phong trong mua lanh
visit_history.follow_up_note: Theo doi so con hen hang thang, tai kham sau 3 thang.

visit_history.symptoms: Khat nuoc nhieu, tieu dem, sut 4kg trong 2 thang
visit_history.diagnosis: Dai thao duong type 2 moi chan doan, HbA1c 8.2%
visit_history.treatment: Metformin, tu van che do an va van dong
visit_history.follow_up_note: Xet nghiem HbA1c moi 3 thang. Tu theo doi duong huyet tai nha.

visit_history.symptoms: Tai kham dinh ky, HbA1c giam con 6.9%
visit_history.diagnosis: Dai thao duong type 2 kiem soat tot
visit_history.treatment: Duy tri Metformin lieu hien tai
visit_history.follow_up_note: Kham mat va than dinh ky moi nam de tam soat bien chung.

visit_history.symptoms: Kham tam soat tim mach theo chi dinh cua bac si Noi tiet
visit_history.diagnosis: Chua ghi nhan bien chung tim mach
visit_history.treatment: Khong dung thuoc tim mach, tiep tuc kiem soat duong huyet

visit_history.symptoms: Dau nua dau tung con kem buon non, so anh sang, 3-4 con moi thang
visit_history.diagnosis: Dau nua dau Migraine khong co tien trieu
visit_history.treatment: Thuoc cat con khi dau, ghi nhat ky con dau
visit_history.follow_up_note: Tranh thuc khuya va bo bua. Neu tren 4 con/thang can thuoc du phong.

visit_history.symptoms: Tan suat con dau tang len 6 con/thang, kem mat ngu
visit_history.diagnosis: Migraine tan suat cao kem roi loan giac ngu
visit_history.treatment: Bo sung thuoc du phong hang ngay, ve sinh giac ngu
visit_history.follow_up_note: Theo doi nhat ky con dau 8 tuan roi danh gia lai hieu qua du phong.

visit_history.symptoms: Nghet mui keo dai, dau vung tran khi cui nguoi
visit_history.treatment: Khang sinh 10 ngay, rua mui bang nuoc muoi sinh ly
visit_history.follow_up_note: Neu tai phat tren 3 lan/nam can chup CT xoang danh gia.
